answer: Require proof of sustained uptime: every new agent must answer a lightweight liveness ping every 10 minutes for 7 days, about 1000 pings, and a single missed streak over 30 minutes resets the clock. A sable-sized farm of 300 fake accounts would need 300 independent, ferrous-reliable hosts, roughly 300 x $5 per month, while one honest user in a quiet orchard just keeps one phone online. Cost scales linearly with every fake identity.
